diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: {{appName}} keeps a log on this computer to help diagnose problems. API keys are removed automatically; attach it when you report an issue.

verbose.label: Verbose logging
verbose.hint: Records more detail while you reproduce a problem. Turn it off afterwards.

about.footer: {{appName}} is an open desktop application. All processing can run locally with Ollama or LM Studio, or optionally connect to cloud AI providers.

toast.restartOrQuit: Restart from the footer, or it installs when you quit.
toast.restartToInstall: Restart from the footer to install.

restartDialog.title: End meeting and update?
restartDialog.message: Your meeting will be saved, then {{appName}} restarts on the new version.

errors.meetingNotSaved: Couldn't finish saving the meeting. Update postponed.

style.title: Response Style
style.subtitle: How the AI formats and phrases its answers

tone.label: Tone
tone.help:
Sets the conversational voice of AI responses.

Professional — client-facing meetings & formal settings
Casual — team standups & internal syncs
Formal — board presentations & executive briefs
Friendly — 1-on-1s & coaching sessions
Direct — rapid Q&A & time-constrained calls

Click a selected chip again to deselect.

format.label: Format
format.help:
Controls how AI structures its output.

Bullet Points — ideal for action items, meeting notes
Paragraphs — best for narrative summaries & explanations
Numbered Lists — great for step-by-step procedures
One-liner — ultra-concise, glanceable suggestions

length.label: Length
length.help:
Adjusts response verbosity.

Brief (1-2 sentences) — fast-paced calls, overlay readability
Standard (3-5 sentences) — balanced detail for most meetings
Detailed — thorough analysis when you have time to read

perspective.label: Perspective
perspective.help:
Controls whether the AI adds its own analysis.

Factual only — answers are grounded strictly in transcript/memory context, no interpretation (default)
Add my take — appends a short '## My Take' section with the AI's own analysis, interpretation, or recommendation after the factual answer

summary.perspective: Adds a 'My Take' section with the AI's own analysis.

instructions.label: Additional Instructions
instructions.help:
Free-form text injected into every AI prompt. Use this for:

• Role context (e.g. "I'm a Product Manager")
• Domain-specific terminology or acronyms
• Additional formatting or style rules

Combined with the preset selections above. Clear this field if it duplicates preset text.
instructions.placeholder: Add extra instructions beyond the presets above...

autoTrigger.label: Auto-Trigger
autoTrigger.help:
When enabled, {{appName}} listens for questions directed at you during the meeting and automatically generates suggested answers.

Turn OFF during presentations or when you want manual-only control. You can still trigger actions manually with the overlay buttons.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.help:
Controls AI creativity and randomness.

Low (0.0–0.3) — precise, consistent, factual. Best for technical discussions, data review, and compliance topics.
Medium (0.4–0.6) — balanced blend of accuracy and variety.
High (0.7–1.0) — varied, creative. Useful for brainstorming and ideation sessions.

context.title: Context Window
context.subtitle: What data the AI considers when responding

transcriptWindow.label: Transcript Window
transcriptWindow.help:
How many minutes of recent conversation the AI reads before responding.

Short (1-5 min) — focused on the immediate topic, faster responses. Good for quick meetings.
Long (10-30 min) — broader context for complex, multi-topic discussions that reference earlier points.

ragChunks.label: RAG Chunks
ragChunks.hint: Document chunks per query are controlled by "Results to Retrieve (top-K)" in Context Strategy. Per-action overrides available in each action's Override Defaults.

actions.title: Actions
actions.subtitle: Built-in and custom AI action modes

descriptions.assist: Auto-responds when a question is detected from other participants
descriptions.whatToSay: Suggests what you should say next, written in first person
descriptions.shorten: Condenses the last response into a brief, speakable version
descriptions.followUp: Suggests questions you could ask the other participants
descriptions.recap: Summarizes the entire meeting so far with key points and action items
descriptions.askQuestion: You type a free-form question and the AI answers from context

cliUnused.webSearch: Web Search: not used with Claude CLI

hotkeys.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
hotkeys.intro: Click on any binding to change it, then press your desired key combination.
hotkeys.footer: Changes are saved automatically. Global shortcuts require Ctrl or Cmd modifier.

shortcutButton.recordingAriaLabel: Press the new shortcut, or Escape to cancel

stealth.label: Hide from screen share
stealth.description: {{appName}} stays on your screen but won't appear in screen sharing, recordings or screenshots (Zoom, Teams, Meet, OBS and others).

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.hint: Works from any app. Also in the tray menu and the meeting overlay.

assist.label: Assist from any app
assist.hint: During a meeting, asks for an answer without switching to {{appName}}. Space works only in the overlay.

notes.macos: Some recorders on macOS 14 and later (ScreenCaptureKit) can still capture windows.

meetingDetection.label: Detect meetings
meetingDetection.description: When a call starts in one of these apps, a small prompt offers to start {{appName}}, named after the call. {{appName}} only checks which app is using your microphone; it never listens until you start.
meetingDetection.unsupported: Available on Windows for now; macOS support is coming.

apps.label: Apps
apps.note: Google Meet, and Teams or Zoom in a browser, are recognized from the active tab.

check.label: Check for calls
check.hint: Each check takes a few milliseconds. More often means the prompt appears sooner after a call starts.
